## Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd (policy CC-1629): theft from a locked office overnight of a soldering station and an oscilloscope at a rented studio on Pike Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 5,876 dollars. The file does not record the date of loss, so the seven-day police reporting condition in exclusion 7.5 needs one confirmation (see Coverage analysis).

## Facts

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the loss on 16 April 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked office overnight [notice of loss]. It occurred at a rented studio on Pike Street [notice of loss]. The items are a soldering station and an oscilloscope [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 18 April 2026 under reference CR/2026/4221 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The soldering station is invoiced at 4,829 dollars and the oscilloscope at 1,047 dollars [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The file contains no date of loss [notice of loss], [police report] and no policy schedule [policy].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the scheduled premises, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The loss is a theft of business contents at a rented studio [notice of loss]. The file does not include the schedule, so the studio's custody status is taken from the rental described in the notice of loss and should be confirmed against the schedule.

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it removes cover for portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space unless it was in a locked container or locked room, and the items were in a locked container within a locked office [police report], [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 requires a police report within seven days where theft is alleged [policy]. The police report is dated 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 16 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. Because the file gives no date of loss, the seven-day period cannot be measured directly. The condition is met if the loss occurred on or after 11 April 2026. The date of loss should be confirmed with the insured and noted on the file before payment.

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the date of loss for exclusion 7.5 as set out above.

## Reserve

The reserve is 5,876 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,829 dollars and 1,047 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown, because the file contains no schedule showing one, and under clause 9.1 none applies [policy].
